nodes.label: Field-Ready Design System
nodes.rationale: Synced (not authored) from the sibling ems-inventory project so this app visually reads as one family with OMD Response and other UTHealth EM tools; must read instantly in sunlight or a dark cab, so the rule is 'quiet, chunky, high-contrast, utilitarian' with one bold element per screen.

nodes.label: Semantic Palette Tokens & Dark-Mode Constraint
nodes.rationale: Dark mode works by remapping a hard-coded list of literal Tailwind utilities in src/index.css; introducing a new literal palette family (zinc/slate/stone/etc.) would silently render light-mode colors in dark mode, so only 8 allowed families plus semantic tokens may be used.

nodes.label: Typography System (Barlow / Barlow Condensed / JetBrains Mono)
nodes.rationale: font-mono reserved for all data readouts (counts, coverage, dates, shift times) so numeric fields read unambiguously at a glance; font-display reserved for titles/stats to keep hierarchy legible under field conditions.

nodes.label: Accessibility Floor
nodes.rationale: Visible keyboard focus, WCAG-AA contrast on tinted status blocks, labeled form fields, aria-labels on icon-only buttons — non-negotiable baseline given the field-use context.
